how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-westfall-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:184:details:0: This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within ⟦E2⟧. It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna. And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:

rows.quest:12:obj:0: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to him on Sentinel Hill.

rows.quest:22:progress:0: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!

rows.quest:64:obj:0: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West.

Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't ⟦E4⟧ it. If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!

rows.quest:64:completion:0: My watch! Thank you so much, kind sir!

rows.quest:92742:title: Testing the Wells

rows.quest:92744:title: Murloc Gills

rows.quest:102:obj:0: Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.

rows.quest:102:progress:0: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
rows.quest:102:completion:0: Well done, ⟦25⟧. With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside ⟦E11⟧, ⟦E2⟧ just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was. Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
rows.quest:151:obj:0: Verna Furlbrow in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats.

rows.quest:151:details:1: I bet you could find some around all of the farms in ⟦E2⟧, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
rows.quest:151:progress:0: Old Blanchy is on her last leg. Did you happen to find any oats for her?
rows.quest:151:completion:0: Thank you so much, ⟦26⟧! ⟦E21⟧ will be so happy!
rows.quest:9:obj:0: Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.

rows.quest:9:details:1: If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them. Come back when you're done for your pay. If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
rows.quest:9:progress:0: Ah, I see you're back! I hope you've been hard at work clearing those fields of those Harvest Watchers. Have you killed twenty yet?
rows.quest:9:completion:0: Good work, friend. You have earned your pay well. Who knows, perhaps ⟦E2⟧ will prosper once again.

rows.quest:92909:title: Harvesting the Harvesters
rows.quest:103:obj:0: Bring 5 ⟦E24⟧ of Oil to Captain Grayson at the ⟦E2⟧ Lighthouse.
rows.quest:103:details:0: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible. I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack. But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline. With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.
rows.quest:103:details:1: Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
rows.quest:103:progress:0: The flame will not burn for long without oil, ⟦34⟧.
rows.quest:103:completion:0: Praise you, brave ⟦35⟧. The rocks of the ⟦E2⟧ Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work. Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.
rows.quest:103:completion:1: I died needlessly on this very shore. My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
rows.quest:136:obj:0: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
rows.quest:136:details:0: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave. So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues.
rows.quest:136:details:1: First ye need to find me footlocker. It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of ⟦E2⟧ near the shipwreck. There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast. Find that anchor and you'll find me locker! Look in there for the next clue.
rows.quest:136:completion:0: The footlocker slowly creaks open. Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait! A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!
rows.quest:138:obj:0: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
rows.quest:138:details:0: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey! Now ye need to head due east. East up the bluffs, east to the road. Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road. There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
rows.quest:139:obj:0: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.
rows.quest:139:details:0: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment. This one reads: Now from this here barrel, face ye North. Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs. If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.
rows.quest:139:completion:0: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
rows.quest:140:obj:0: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
rows.quest:140:details:0: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure. The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text: Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure! Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore. Once ye get to the water, keep going! Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
rows.quest:140:completion:0: The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work. You force the chest open and take the booty.
rows.quest:92749:title: A Dynamite Plan

rows.quest:14:progress:0: ⟦36⟧, now is no time for idle chatter. If you still wish to prove yourself to ⟦E11⟧ you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier. Return to me when you have completed your duty.
rows.quest:14:completion:0: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland. But there is hope for ⟦E2⟧ yet. As proven by your valor in ⟦E27⟧, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor. It is with great pride that I induct thee into ⟦E11⟧. May the Light shine upon you.
rows.quest:65:obj:0: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to talk to Wiley in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:65:details:0: The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of ⟦E2⟧ from the land call themselves ⟦E28⟧. I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs. We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out. In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.
rows.quest:65:details:1: ⟦E29⟧ to Lakeshire in the ⟦E30⟧, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
rows.quest:65:completion:0: So, Stoutmantle sent you? Well, I owe him.
rows.quest:132:details:0: What I am about to tell you could cost me my life. The Defias gang is up to something big. Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.
rows.quest:132:details:1: Take this note to Stoutmantle. It explains as much as I know on the subject.
rows.quest:132:progress:0: Good to see you back, ⟦37⟧. What did Wiley have to say for himself?
rows.quest:132:completion:0: Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the ⟦E32⟧. But this information is crucial. Good work.
rows.quest:135:details:0: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons. Perhaps that was a slip of tongue. Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons? Only one man would know for sure: Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him ⟦E31⟧ and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
rows.quest:135:progress:0: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man. . .
rows.quest:135:completion:0: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
rows.quest:141:obj:0: Take Shaw's report to Gryan Stoutmantle in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:141:details:0: The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef. VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding ⟦E5⟧ after the orcs razed it in the First War. Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete. That just might explain a thing or two.
rows.quest:141:details:1: I have written a more detailed account for your Master in ⟦E2⟧. Take this to him at once!
rows.quest:141:progress:0: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
rows.quest:141:completion:0: Edwin VanCleef. . .I know the name well. To think that a man so industrious and talented could turn into such a scoundrel unnerves me. I'll need further proof before I believe this.
